data.title: Miracles Page
data.description: Explore the inexplicable divine miracles associated with Lord Jagannath's temple in Puri that have amazed devotees for centuries.

content.body: For centuries, the Jagannath Temple in Puri has been a site of numerous inexplicable divine phenomena. These miracles continue to amaze devotees and skeptics alike, standing as testimony to Lord Jagannath's divine presence.

These divine miracles associated with Lord Jagannath challenge our understanding of natural laws. While scientific minds seek explanations, devotees see them as manifestations of the Lord's divine power that transcends human comprehension.

Whether you approach these phenomena as a believer or a curious observer, they invite us to contemplate the mysteries that exist beyond the realm of ordinary explanation.

data.title: About Jagannath Tales
data.description: Learn about our mission to preserve and share the divine stories, miracles, and cultural heritage associated with Lord Jagannath's temple in Puri.

content.body:
Welcome to Jagannath Tales

A project dedicated to sharing the divine stories of Lord Jagannath from Puri, Odisha, India.

Lord Jagannath, the "Lord of the Universe," is worshipped in the famous Jagannath Temple in Puri, Odisha. The distinctive wooden idols of Lord Jagannath, his brother Balabhadra, and sister Subhadra are revered by millions of devotees worldwide.

This website aims to collect and present devotional stories related to Lord Jagannath and his leelas (divine plays) to make these treasures accessible to people across the globe.
To preserve and promote the rich spiritual heritage associated with Lord Jagannath through storytelling, making these divine tales accessible to devotees.
This site is built using Next.js with TypeScript and is statically generated. It fetches content from JSON data files.
